description: The chart illustrates the percentage point difference across various hidden layer configurations in a neural network model. The horizontal axis lists different configurations, labeled as "hidden:[1], linear", "hidden:[100], ReLU", and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU", indicating the number of hidden layers and the activation functions used. The vertical axis is labeled "% point difference" and ranges from -0.1 to 0.3, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Each configuration is represented by a pair of bars, colored in light blue and dark blue, with the light blue bar appearing to be slightly shorter or longer than the dark blue bar in some cases. The bars for "hidden:[1], linear" have values around -0.08 and 0.05, for "hidden:[100], ReLU" around 0.18 and 0.3, and for "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU" around 0.23 and 0.25. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any specific bar. The chart presents the percentage point differences for different hidden layer configurations, with paired bars for each configuration, allowing for a visual comparison of the values across different settings.
